name: King Abdulaziz University
description: King Abdulaziz University in Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's research powerhouses, strategically positioned on the Red Sea coast with a world-leading marine science and coral-reef research program that draws heavily from the nearby King Abdullah Economic City infrastructure. The university's Center of Excellence in Desalination Technology is a major applied-science hub, funded through Vision 2030 and KACST grants, and represents a significant procurement center for membrane technology, sensor systems, and water-quality instrumentation. KAU's medical campus operates several advanced imaging and genomics facilities underpinned by generous government R&D appropriations, making it one of the Middle East's most active buyers of life-science equipment. International vendors should note that KAU's procurement is largely tender-based with a preference for established distributors holding GCC trade licenses.
